title: Colleagues' grandparents were UFO report people on the Manhattan Project

tellings.quote:
there are some people I'm uh colleagues

plain: During the 1940s, some people on the Manhattan Project, the wartime US program that built the atomic bomb, are said to have had the job of handling UFO reports. David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer, tells Michels he has colleagues whose "grandparents were actually you know the UFO report people on the Manhattan Project." If true, it would mean the government was tracking UFOs inside its most secret wartime project, before the modern UFO era began.
